# Psalm 110 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 110:3 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** Your-people freewill-offerings in-day-of your-power; in-splendors-of holiness from-womb-of the-dawn, to-you the-dew-of your-youth.
- **LOGOS:** Your people will offer themselves freely on the day of your power, in holy garments; from the womb of the morning, the dew of your youth will be yours.
- **PNEUMA:** Your people will volunteer freely when you lead them into battle, dressed in holy splendor. Your young warriors will come to you fresh as the morning dew.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.
